absences: NRC Part 57 final rule due date of 2026-11-23: only one search summary states it, and the NRC proposed-rule page (last updated 2026-09-14) states no final schedule. Not verified against a primary source, so no check or item was written on it.
Part 57 scope: the NRC chairman's remark (100 MWe or less) conflicts with a trade-press description (20 MWe or less). Not resolved; not written as a correction.

Federal Register text of the NRC final rule on prior DOE/DoW authorization (public-inspection document 2026-21801): the PDF did not parse in WebFetch. Its publication date (scheduled 2026-10-28 per ANS) falls before the 2026-10-30 window, so it was not written as an item.

Congress, Oct 31 to Nov 9 2026: no NDAA, appropriations or continuing-resolution action on nuclear or microreactor provisions found. Found only pre-window House committee and floor action (HASC 2026-06-04, House floor July 2026) and a Senate SASC markup (2026-06-11) that one opinion column says has no similar provision; the SASC bill text was not fetched.

FY2027 Energy and Water appropriations: House committee approved 2026-05-20; no later status or stopgap found. The ARDP line in the House and enacted figures could not be confirmed from a primary source.

NRC commission votes or approvals, Oct 31 to Nov 9 2026: none found. NRC news index shows only 2026-10-30 (contested-hearing final rule, on the window boundary and excluded by the strictly-after rule) and 2026-11-03 (Chairman Nieh INPO remarks, a speech with no decision).

DOE Reactor Pilot Program or Launch Pad authorizations after 2026-10-30: none found. Launch Pad second-round selections (about 2026-08-25) and the Aalo-X criticality are pre-window or already shipped.
DoW or Army policy after 2026-10-30: none found. Army Janus vendor awards (2026-08-26) and the Department of War Naval Weapons Station Crane announcement (2026-09-09) are pre-window.

State laws Oct 31 to Nov 9 2026: no microreactor or advanced nuclear bill signing found. New Jersey S4849 (introduced 2026-10-19) is already shipped in dockets; the Assembly companion (introduced 2026-10-29) was not separately fetched.

PUC or utility dockets filed in the last 90 days naming SMRs or microreactors: none found with a fetched filing. Duke Energy Kentucky 2026 IRP (case 2026-00167, filed 2026-06-17) falls outside 90 days. Louisiana R-37871 is already shipped; its 2026-09-16 agenda shows a final-rule vote, outcome not found.
Virginia SMR cost recovery (Appalachian Power, Dominion PUR-2024-00205): pre-window or outcome not found.

CNSC and ONR: no 2026 change in microreactor licensing found. ONR published a new Licensing Nuclear Installations guide (May 2026, secondary source) and a revised GDA framework (2026-05-26, legal summary), both before the window and not fetched from ONR.

NRC construction permit for the TVA Clinch River BWRX-300: reported in an NCSL newsletter (October 2026) with conflicting timing; a 300 MWe reactor, outside the 1-20 MW buyer scope; not verified against NRC.
Price-Anderson: no 2026 legislation found. Only the 2024 extension (to 2065-12-31) was found, and it is already context for shipped material.

checks.claim: cut the hourly rate advanced-reactor applicants pay for review from $318 to $148 (under the FY2026 fee rule it is $154, against a full rate of $337), a concrete cost advantage available now.
checks.evidence: The NRC fee rule 'Fee Schedules; Fee Recovery for Fiscal Year 2026' (Federal Register, published 2026-06-16, effective 2026-08-17) sets the FY2026 Reduced Hourly Rate for advanced reactor applicants at $154 per hour, against a professional hourly rate of $337. The shipped lead figure of $148 is not the FY2026 rate. The $318 prior figure was not checked against a source.

The page was last reviewed/updated 2026-09-14, and it links to 91 FR 23628 (proposed 2026-05-01, docket NRC-2025-0379). The proposed-stage status is confirmed; the 2026-11-23 final-rule date is not stated on this page and is not verified.
